channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: Type 32 frigate programme remains in limbo
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has again declined to provide clarity on the future of the Royal Navy’s Type 32 frigate programme, saying all platform decisions will be taken as part of the forthcoming Defence Investment Plan. The post Type 32 frigate programme remains in limbo first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: RFA seafarers vote overwhelmingly for strike action
item.description: Maritime union RMT has welcomed what it described as an overwhelming vote for strike action by Royal Fleet Auxiliary (RFA) seafarers, warning that management could not demonstrate it was complying with minimum wage legislation. The post RFA seafarers vote overwhelmingly for strike action first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK tips Leonardo for Chinook, Merlin and Wildcat radio deal
item.description: The UK intends to award Leonardo UK a contract for repair and post-design support services for avionics communications equipment used across the Chinook, Merlin and Wildcat helicopter fleets. The post UK tips Leonardo for Chinook, Merlin and Wildcat radio deal first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: HMS Albion being used to get HMS Bulwark ready for handover
item.description: HMS Albion is being retained at Devonport to support preparations for the sale of HMS Bulwark to Brazil, however, no disposal plans have yet been confirmed for Albion itself. The post HMS Albion being used to get HMS Bulwark ready for handover first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Men jailed over foiled Islamic terror plot
item.description: Three men have been jailed after being convicted over a foiled terrorist plot aimed at the Jewish community in Greater Manchester. The post Men jailed over foiled Islamic terror plot first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Private firm signs deal to acquire UK Wave Class RFA tankers
item.description: A private maritime company has announced it has signed an agreement to acquire the Royal Fleet Auxiliary's two Wave Class fast fleet tankers, Wave Knight and Wave Ruler The post Private firm signs deal to acquire UK Wave Class RFA tankers first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: MOD denies claims of airborne forces cuts
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has denied claims that the UK is planning to reduce airborne capability or cut pay for paratroopers, following reporting parachute forces may move to a smaller specialist structure. The post MOD denies claims of airborne forces cuts first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: KNDS and EOS agree to pursue new weapon station projects
item.description: KNDS and EOS Defence Systems have signed a teaming agreement aimed at expanding cooperation on remote-controlled weapon stations and associated weapons. The post KNDS and EOS agree to pursue new weapon station projects first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Lithuania orders Leopard 2 bridge layers in KNDS deal
item.description: Lithuania has commissioned KNDS Deutschland to deliver twelve LEGUAN bridge layer vehicles based on the Leopard 2 chassis. The post Lithuania orders Leopard 2 bridge layers in KNDS deal first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: MOD outlines plan to upgrade military family housing
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has set out measures it says are underway to improve the quality, maintenance and availability of Service Family Accommodation. The post MOD outlines plan to upgrade military family housing first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
